title: How a Godly Man Leads When Leading Costs Him Something
caption:
Real leadership was never about the title. It cost Christ his life for the people he led, so a godly man measures it the same way: what is he willing to go first into.

He apologizes first, even when he's only half wrong, because somebody has to break the standoff. He serves before he's thanked, the dishes and the midnight ride nobody's tracking. When blame is about to land on someone smaller, he steps in front of it. And when the group's been avoiding the true thing, he's the one who says it.

Waiting for someone else to go first isn't humility. It's hiding.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
